title: Crystal Bridges
subtitle: Museum of American Art
tagline: Moshe Safdie's pavilions around Crystal Spring's ponds
format: Shape follows musewalk's gallery.config.json (wings / theme hexes / frameStyle / works). Works name a public-domain file from public/art/sources.json by `art`, or are `placeholder: true` (still in copyright: empty frame + real label, never reproduced).

wings.name: Garrison Lobby
wings.intro: Visitors arrive at the crest of the ravine and come down into the lobby, with the ponds and both bridges in view.

wings.name: Early American Art
wings.intro: Curved walls, concave timber ceilings and red-oak floors. Landscapes of the Hudson River School.

works.desc: Asher B. Durand painted Thomas Cole and the poet William Cullen Bryant together on a ledge above a Catskills gorge, a tribute made after Cole's death in 1848.
works.line: Two friends, one gorge, and the light that outlasts them.
A homestead small against an enormous evening.
Wilderness, before the axe.
The volcano rests in the distance; the ruins stay near.
A shepherd, a flock, and the end of a long afternoon.
A meadow that runs all the way to the mountain.
Water falling for as long as anyone has looked.
A whole village out in the snow.
Still water, still sails, still hills.
Soft light over a quiet valley.
Everyone leans toward the newspaper.
A clearing cut out of the forest.

wings.name: People on the Move
wings.intro: Glulam beams of southern pine, made in Arkansas, pass through the glass walls to the outside.

works.line: Smoke rising into a mountain evening.
A ship at rest, ropes slack.
Autumn spills down the valley.
Rock, water and weather.
A thread of water down a granite wall.
The cliff keeps watch over the valley.
A road you have walked in a dream.
The river holds the last of the sun.
A whole town out in the bog.
The hunt turns.
Dusk, and a shepherd counting.

wings.name: Modern Art Bridge
wings.intro: A copper roof hung from cables over the lower pond; glass walls lean out over the water.

works.line: A restless writer, caught mid-stride.
Gaslight comes on along the boulevard.
Salt air and summer colour.
A page turns in a quiet room.
A white city built for a single summer.
The light thins toward autumn.
Moon, mist and a small boat.

wings.name: Lower North Gallery
wings.intro: A low, tight gallery before the bridge opens out over the pond.

works.line: Night work on a hole in the city.
Saturday night on the street.
Mountains stacked like music.
A night-herder sings to the cattle.
A village made of hard colour.

wings.name: Contemporary Art
wings.intro: Higher ceilings and a long curved wall. These works are still in copyright, so the frames hang empty with their labels.

wings.name: Great Hall Corridor
wings.intro: A curved glass colonnade along the upper pond; reflections from the water ripple over the walls.

wings.name: Great Hall
wings.intro: A cable-hung roof over a hall that stands in the upper pond, with water on three sides.

wings.name: Eleven
wings.intro: The restaurant bridge spans the weir between the two ponds. Its floor is green quartzite, matched to the colour of the water.

wings.name: Library
wings.intro: More than sixty thousand volumes, with one of the best views over the upper pond.

wings.name: West Galleries (2026)
wings.intro: Opened in June 2026: new galleries under long-span southern yellow pine beams. Works shown here are stand-ins.

wings.name: Bridge Gallery (2026)
wings.intro: A glass bridge over the new pond, with a forty-seat café at its midpoint.
